step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a continuous-time equivalent model of a switched-capacitor integrator, a core building block in the double-sampling extended-counting ADC described in the paper. It utilizes an operational amplifier with capacitive feedback to transfer and hold charge from the input.

Closed_Loop_Gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain of the charge amplifier, determined by the capacitor ratio C1/C3.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = 20 * log10(C1/C3). With C1=1pF and C3=1pF, gain is 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined purely by passive component ratios in the macro-model.

Bandwidth_3dB.description: The frequency at which the closed-loop gain drops by 3 dB from its low-frequency value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Closed-loop BW ≈ GBW * (C3 / (C1 + C3 + Cp)). For GBW=40MHz and C1=C3=1pF, BW ≈ 20 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the operational amplifier's gain-bandwidth product and the feedback factor.

Settling_Time.description: Time required for the output to settle within 1% of its final value after an input step.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_settle ≈ -ln(0.01) / (2 * pi * BW). For BW=20MHz, t_settle ≈ 4.6 / (1.25e8) ≈ 36 ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Settling time is inversely proportional to the closed-loop bandwidth. The paper's 15ns implies a higher effective bandwidth during the specific clock phase.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure closed-loop AC gain, -3dB bandwidth, and transient settling time of the charge amplifier using an op-amp macro-model.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Double-Sampling Extended-Counting ADC - Charge Amplifier Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Component Values
.param C1_val=1p C3_val=1p Cp_val=0.1p C2_val=1p CpL_val=0.1p

* DUT (Extracted Netlist)
I1 Vin GND 0
C1 Vin N1 {C1_val}
Cp N1 GND {Cp_val}
C3 N1 Vout {C3_val}
* Replaced A1 with standard subcircuit call X1
X1 N1 GND Vout amplifier
C2 Vout GND {C2_val}
CpL Vout GND {CpL_val}

* Op-amp Macro-model (GBW = 40MHz, DC Gain = 100dB)
.subckt amplifier in_m in_p out
  G1 0 int in_p in_m 1m
  R1 int 0 100MEG
  C1 int 0 3.98p
  E1 out 0 int 0 1
.ends

* Stimulus
* AC: 1V for Bode plot. Tran: 0V to 1V step for settling time.
VVIN Vin GND DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 1 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)

.control
  * 1. AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1k 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(Vout)
  
  * Measure low frequency gain
  meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=1k
  
  * Measure -3dB bandwidth
  let target_gain = low_freq_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=target_gain fall=1

  * 2. Transient Analysis
  tran 0.1n 100n
  
  * Measure settling time (1% of final value)
  * Input steps from 0 to 1V. Ideal inverting gain is -1, so output steps 0 to -1V.
  * 1% settling means reaching -0.99V.
  meas tran t_settle trig v(Vin) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(Vout) val=-0.99 fall=1

  print low_freq_gain bw_3db t_settle
  quit
.endc

.end
